messages:
Maria: Hey infra — need a quick capacity sanity check. Partner demo next Tue 13:00 UTC, need ~6x A100 (40GB) for a 4h reserved window. Can we either reserve or temporarily swap with some noncritical training jobs? Timeline: booking by EOD tomorrow. pinging @Raj and @Sophia.

Raj: Region? eu-west1-a or eu-central?

Maria: eu-west1-a. Pref lower latency for partner. Could also do eu-central if no quota.

infra-bot: Quota scan started: project/redwood-demo shows available GPUs: A100(40GB): 2 free in eu-west1-a, 8 free across eu-west1 region. Preemptible capacity: 12. Note: quota limits may be per-zone. Dashboard: https://internal.quota/redwood-demo (procurement tag required)

Kevin: We have 2 preemptible A100s in eu-west1-a reserved for batch-training (team: ml-load). Can we shift those to preemptible fallback + burst? Might need a 2h advance notice to migrate training.

Sophia: Vendor update — our cloud partner has 6 ephemeral A100s in eu-west1 available on request but they need a signed usage window. Lead time ~24h. @Maria we can carve them for 4h if procurement signs off.

Maria: If vendor can carve them, we'll take vendor ephemerals. Otherwise fallback to eu-central1 (we confirmed 6 A100s free there). Which is lower friction?

Raj: eu-central1 has 6 non-preemptible A100s free but network latency to partner might increase ~30ms. If the demo is latency-sensitive, prefer vendor carve in eu-west1.

Kevin: If we borrow ml-load's reserved preemptibles, we should schedule a canary to ensure checkpoints run earlier. I can script the eviction safeguard.

Kevin: ```bash
# drain training nodes gracefully
kubectl cordon gpu-node-ml-*
kubectl drain gpu-node-ml-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600
# move job to backup queue
gcloud compute instances stop gpu-train-*
```

Maria: That script looks good. Can you run it Monday night? We'd prefer vendor carve now to avoid touching production training.

Sophia: I'll start procurement thread. ETA for signed usage window: 10-12h. If we don't have signed window by 02:00 UTC tomorrow, fallback to eu-central1 and @Raj can we confirm network test?

Raj: I'll run a latency test to partner endpoint from eu-central1 and eu-west1 and post numbers within 3h.

infra-bot: Note: creating ephemeral vendor instances requires a ticket to infra-procurement with SLA tag "demo-burst". See runbook: https://internal.runbooks/procure-ephemeral (auto-note)

Raj: Latency results: eu-west1-a -> partner 18ms; eu-central1 -> partner 47ms. Recommend eu-west1 for latency-sensitive demo.

Maria: Ok locking to vendor carve in eu-west1 if procurement returns signed window. Thx everyone :heart:

Kevin: I'll make the drain script a one-liner cron to run if we need it; will keep in my agenda.

Sophia: Procure ticket created: PR-3421. Tagging legal + procurement. Will update thread when signed.

Maria: Closing loop — will confirm to partner by EOD. Thanks!
